_comment: Offline-first advisory seed for the OSV.dev dependency module (detection class 4). This small, curated list of well-documented public advisories lets the scanner flag the most common vulnerable pins with zero network access (air-gapped). When --osv is passed, the live OSV.dev API supplements this list; on any network failure the scanner degrades to this offline set. Each entry records public advisory identifiers (OSV / CVE / GHSA) as factual references; the summaries are re-authored, not copied. 'vulnerable' is a comma-separated set of version constraints that ALL must hold for a coordinate to be considered affected; '*' matches every version.

advisories.summary: requests before 2.20.0 sends the Authorization header to a different host across an HTTPS-to-HTTP redirect, leaking credentials.
urllib3 before 1.24.2 mishandles certificate verification when a CA directory is supplied, weakening TLS validation.
PyYAML before 5.4 allows arbitrary code execution when untrusted input is parsed with the full loader (yaml.load without SafeLoader).
lodash before 4.17.12 is vulnerable to prototype pollution via defaultsDeep, allowing modification of Object.prototype.
minimist before 1.2.6 is vulnerable to prototype pollution through crafted command-line arguments.
